{{Quote|One of my first jobs was as a street tout for a restaurant on the great starship yards of Fondor (which doesn't really have streets, but that's beside the point). I gave "friendly" advice to the shipyard's visitors--gullible tourists fresh off the Starspeeders were always the best targets--inevitably directing them to the restaurant I was fronting.|Dexter Jettster on working for the restaurant|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''restaurant''' operated at the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]<ref name="Menu" /> in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]<ref name="Atlast">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> at some point before [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Dining at Dex's]]" states that the [[Unidentified Fondor restaurant|Fondor restaurant]] was [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] first exposure to the food service industry. Since ''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' depicts Jettster running a bar during [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] must have worked at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] before that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] worked as a street tout for [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] where he learned how to prepare several recipes, including the [[shaak and cheese sandwich]] sold there. Jettster later opened his own restaurant, [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he sold [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]] and cheese [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwiches]] using the same recipe.<ref name="Menu" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The restaurant was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
